meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作按时间轴编排的可渲染视觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过代码和 HTML 亲手制作动态影像作品
copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft dynamic animations with code and HTML.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范编写视频组合的 HTML：用 data-* 属性控制时间、class="clip" 标记片段、安排轨道与子组合，并遵守可确定性渲染的规则。
howto.when: 当你要构建或修改 HyperFrames 组合、使用 data-* 时序属性或 clip 片段等，或涉及 STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md 计划格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个最小的 HyperFrames 组合 HTML
say.note: Claude 会给出最小可渲染的组合骨架。

say.text: 给这个片段设置 data-track-index，让它跟上一段重叠
say.note: Claude 会调整轨道参数并说明时序影响。

say.text: 运行 npx hyperframes check，看组合有没有问题
say.note: Claude 会调用 CLI 做检查并汇报结果。

howto.what_en: Claude will build HyperFrames composition HTML per the spec: declare timing with data-* attributes, mark clips with class="clip", arrange tracks and sub-compositions, and follow deterministic-render rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or edit a HyperFrames composition, use data-* timing attributes or clip classes, or work with STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats.

say_en.text: Create a minimal HyperFrames composition HTML for me.
say_en.note: Claude returns a minimal renderable skeleton.

say_en.text: Set data-track-index on this clip so it overlaps the previous one.
say_en.note: Claude adjusts track timing and explains the effect.

say_en.text: Run npx hyperframes check on my composition.
say_en.note: Claude runs the CLI check and reports findings.
